model.name: H3 Legacy Quality — ConvRot
model.description: Exact high-quality legacy route preserved in HocusPocus: isolated ComfyUI runtime, pruned INT8 ConvRot FL2VA transformer and matching Qwen3-VL 32B INT8 ConvRot encoder. Fixed at 20 steps with Turbo, cache and LoRAs disabled. Creates text or first/last-frame video with synchronized stereo audio.

prompt: A man with a purple beanie, reflective aviator sunglasses, a thick black beard and mustache covered in glowing blue circuit patterns, wearing a yellow and black circuit-patterned jacket, and a green parrot with a red head on his shoulder. He looks at the camera and clearly says in English: "PlayStation 1 style." Classic low-poly PS1 aesthetic, affine texture warping, heavy dithering, jagged edges. 3 second clip.
